name: Empire of Roses
source:
Empire of Roses is a Doki Doki-style horror visual novel made by bored high schoolers. Follow the path of Robert, a high school junior finding a girl to ask out to prom. Play through the minigames and uncover the dark secrets of this so-called "world" you live in, and the dark past that still haunts you. How many endings can you get?

[From [url=https://af267.itch.io/empire-of-roses]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Empire of Roses》是一部由几名闲得无聊的高中生制作、风格类似《心跳文学部》的恐怖视觉小说。跟随高二学生罗伯特，寻找愿意接受毕业舞会邀约的女孩。游玩小游戏，揭开你所处这个所谓“世界”的黑暗秘密，以及至今仍纠缠着你的阴暗过去。你能达成多少个结局？

[摘自[url=https://af267.itch.io/empire-of-roses]itch.io[/url]]
